outOfScope: Creating a third Blackboard lane or replacing the existing Research/Worker ownership model.
Making JEV prescribe implementation patches, execute repairs, or become the authority that mutates candidate source.
Changing provider/model selection, JEV scoring prompts, branch protection, or unrelated CI selection behavior.
Treating agent-authored explanation, plans, or proof documents as sufficient evidence of implementation correctness.
Product-runtime feedback/self-improvement semantics inside packages/agentic-system unless research proves a shared primitive is required.
constraints: RESEARCH_SA only until a fresh JEV readiness judgment accepts the exact plan; this registration does not authorize implementation changes.
Preserve the two-lane Research/Worker model; do not create a third lane for supervision.
JEV remains an independent semantic judge and must not become the actor or prescribe code edits; supervisory control consumes its structured findings.
A failed judgment must not grant source-write repair authority until the actor has produced a judgment-bound lookback/reconsideration that changes epistemic state.
Agent-authored prose or artifact existence alone is not implementation evidence and must not satisfy a finding or material-delta check.
CI remains an enforcement/projection surface; local and CI paths must consume one canonical supervision/transition policy rather than separate gate semantics.
invariants: A failed Worker judgment changes epistemic/control state before it can grant source-write repair authority.
Every lookback and subsequent repair is bound to the exact prior judgment, candidate and plan; stale feedback cannot supervise a new subject.
JEV judges claims/evidence independently; the actor owns diagnosis and repair strategy, and self-authored prose cannot substitute for observed evidence.
Re-evaluation requires material progress against prior findings; repeated unchanged failure cannot be converted into progress by retry count.

architectureDecisions: D1 — Add WORKER/LOOKBACK as a first-class Worker phase between a REPAIR_REQUIRED JEV publication and WORKER/REPAIR. It is a phase, not a lane; source write scope is empty in LOOKBACK. A hidden lookbackRequired flag inside REPAIR is rejected because it hides authority state and conflicts with phase-complete onboarding.

D2 — Keep the JEV provider response typed and non-prescriptive in v1. Do not persist provider free text. A deterministic SUPERVISION_FINDING_SET_V1 is projected from the exact failed evaluation + plan + implementation-result and contains failed question ids, typed failure choices, owned criterion/invariant/negative/Living statements, exact candidate/evidence bindings, findingSignature and repeatCount.

D3 — Add SUPERVISION_LOOKBACK_V1 as actor-owned epistemic state at docs/blackboard/artifacts/ready-implement-plan/<WORK_ID>.lookback.json. It binds exact plan/evaluation/candidate/evidence/findingSignature and requires one diagnosis per failed question plus strategyRevision {strategyClass, priorStrategyRef, changes, intentionallyUnchanged, expectedFreshEvidence} and mode DIAGNOSIS|STRATEGY_RECONSIDERATION. It cannot contain acceptance/delivery authority.

D4 — Publishing a structurally complete, exact-bound lookback is the only LOOKBACK→REPAIR transition. The lookback is not correctness evidence; it grants one repair attempt because the actor has explicitly revised its understanding/strategy. Stale evaluation/candidate/evidence bindings fail closed.

D5 — Persist compact SUPERVISION_STATE_V1 on the current task contract: lastFailedEvaluationRef, failedCandidateSha, failedCandidateTree, failedEvidenceHash, findingSignature, repeatCount, lookbackRef, lookbackHash and mode. No session transcript or generic history chain is introduced.

D6 — Before any subsequent Worker JEV provider dispatch, assert material progress against SUPERVISION_STATE_V1. IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT requires candidate-tree delta; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE requires implementation-result/evidence-hash delta; mixed failures require both. Lookback prose/control-only changes never count. PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION still returns directly to RESEARCH_SA.

D7 — findingSignature is hash(sorted(nonSatisfied questionId + ':' + choice)). A different signature resets repeatCount and uses DIAGNOSIS. The same signature on the next failed cycle increments repeatCount and selects STRATEGY_RECONSIDERATION, which must reference the prior strategy and state why it failed plus an alternative strategy class. Repeat count alone never declares plan contradiction.

D8 — Add pure scripts/blackboard-supervision.mjs. blackboard-jev.mjs uses it for finding/material-progress validation reached by local CLI and trusted-base CI; blackboard-delivery.mjs uses it for transitions. blackboard-jev-ci.mjs stays a thin data-only adapter and owns no separate supervision policy.

D9 — BB-152 becomes a direct Worker dependency. BB-153 extends the delivered phase-local delivery envelope with LOOKBACK instead of creating a parallel bootstrap policy. Worker start binds exact DONE BB-152; incompatible delivered seams are PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION before writes.

D10 — Evidence truth remains observation-first. JEV choice + exact criterion/evidence identify what must be reconsidered, actor diagnosis guides strategy, but only fresh candidate/evidence plus the next JEV judgment determine resolution.
implementationSlices: S1 — Supervisor primitive [SUPERVISORY_LOOP, LOOKBACK_BINDING]: add LOOKBACK to the Worker phase contract and implement blackboard-supervision.mjs finding projection, SUPERVISION_STATE_V1 and exact-bound SUPERVISION_LOOKBACK_V1 validation.

S2 — Control transition [SUPERVISORY_LOOP, LOOKBACK_BINDING]: publish Worker REPAIR_REQUIRED into LOOKBACK; derive read-only LOOKBACK delivery/bootstrap intent; add publish-lookback transition into REPAIR with stale-binding/forbidden-authority failures.
S3 — Anti-spam progress [MATERIAL_DELTA, EVIDENCE_TRUTH]: enforce failure-class-specific candidate/evidence material delta before Worker JEV provider dispatch and ignore lookback/control-only churn.
S4 — Repeated-failure supervision [MATERIAL_DELTA]: compute findingSignature/repeatCount and route repeated identical failures to STRATEGY_RECONSIDERATION with prior-strategy binding.

S5 — Shared local/CI semantics + BB-152 migration [SHARED_SEMANTICS, BB152_INTEGRATION]: route both evaluator entry paths through blackboard-jev.mjs -> blackboard-supervision.mjs; keep CI adapter data-only; extend BB-152 LOOKBACK onboarding; update tests/docs.
